summary: A projection change during a checkpoint capture re-reads only the capture's protection pass, not the whole store

replay.detail: No claim, projection or replay change.

schema.detail: Local guard only: opening the store adds a protection column to checkpoint_capture_epoch and moves the projection-table fences to new trigger names that increment it. History fences are unchanged and the trigger version stays 3.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests unchanged; a finished capture protects the same claims a fresh one does.

compatibility.detail: The staging format moves to 2, so a capture staged by an older build starts again once.

recovery.detail: An older build reinstalls its own projection fences, which move the epoch, when it opens the store; the protection fences beside them are harmless to it, and this build removes the older ones again on its next open.
